summary: Iteration 11 — verified the new styled .xlsx month packs for both workspaces. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_xlsx_export.py (33 tests, 31 pass / 2 documented defects, run with `-n 0`). MIS pack (GET /api/mis/export?format=xlsx, Sunrise Residency 2026-08): correct media type + filename societyhub-sunrise-residency-2026-08.xlsx, EXACTLY the 5 sheets ['Water Reconciliation','Water Usage (Meters)','Tanker Purchases','Charges','Ledger']; navy 1F3864 bold-white headers on every sheet, thin borders on data cells, #,##0.00 on all money columns, C9D7EE TOTAL rows, frozen panes and explicit column widths. Water Reconciliation: the 15 columns in the exact required order, every value equals GET /api/statement (101: 927.44/999.57/1927.01/5025/6952.01/0/15900/1800/-10747.99, TOTAL 4451.71/3998.29/8450/20100/28550/0/28550/4800/-4800), balance bold red when positive (102, 202) and bold green when negative (101, 201), DD-MM-YYYY payment dates ('—' when unpaid), Summary legend (total expense 28550, split 4, per head 7137.5, receivable 6048.66, payable 10848.66, net -4800) and 'Colour key — owner'. Colour coding verified by reading cell fills: each of the 4 owners has one distinct tint applied to every cell of their row, tints are stable between the Reconciliation and Ledger sheets. Meters sheet: 10 headers incl. 'Combined (per flat)', one distinct tint per meter number, 'Colour key — meter'; created a temporary 2nd meter on flat 101 ('QA Meter 9X/1 (Sump) #2') and confirmed the two meters of the same flat carry TWO different tints and the label is written verbatim (then deleted). Original names verified: Owner column contains the raw stored names ('Ramesh Kumar', no '(tenant)' suffix) while the on-screen/PDF column keeps the tenant suffix as designed; renaming an owner to "QA Verbatim O'Brien-Kumar  Jr." via PUT /api/flats and re-downloading showed the new value verbatim (restored afterwards). Tankers sheet: 12 headers incl. 'Lorry paid by'/'Tips paid by' with a row where the tips payer (201 tenant) differs from the lorry payer (101 owner), DD-MM-YYYY dates, TOTAL + Summary/per-head. Charges sheet: two blue (2F5597) section bands 'Recurring — 3 entries' / 'One-time / repairs — 2 entries', each with its own shaded TOTAL (8500 and 11600) and 'Per head' cell. Ledger: 8 headers, Received/Payout direction, money format, TOTAL 4800 + payouts note, owner colour key. Rentals pack (GET /api/rentals/export?format=xlsx, 2026-08): media type + filename societyhub-properties-2026-08.xlsx, EXACT sheets ['Rent Roll','Collections','Payouts','Building Settlement','Deposits'], navy headers everywhere, Rent Roll 17 columns matching /api/rentals/statement (to-collect/balance), one distinct tint per property carried consistently onto Collections/Payouts/Deposits, property names verbatim, Summary + 'Colour key — property', TOTAL row, frozen panes; Collections show DD-MM-YYYY, Mode as Cash/UPI/Bank Transfer and a non-empty Reference column; Building Settlement values match the API. Seeded 2 extra collections (cash + bank with reference), 1 payout and 1 deposit for the month so every sheet had data, all deleted afterwards (verified DB back to 1 payment / 0 payouts / 0 deposits). Regression: MIS CSV+PDF, Annual CSV+PDF, Rentals CSV+PDF all 200 with the iteration-10 layout; test_iter9 + test_iter10 + auth playbook suites = 39/39 green. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): admin login → Maintenance workspace → MIS Report shows Excel/CSV/PDF buttons (export-xlsx-btn/export-csv-btn/export-pdf-btn) and all three download successfully (mis-2026-08.xlsx 13,013 bytes and a valid xlsx zip package, .csv, .pdf); Property workspace → Reports shows rent-export-xlsx-btn which downloads properties-2026-08.xlsx (valid package); Reconciliation/Water/Charges/Setup and rentals pages render with ZERO console/page errors.

minor.issue: The single owner Palette is reused for tanker payers and charge 'fronted by' cells, which are FLAT NUMBERS. So the Ledger 'Colour key — owner' block lists '101','102','201','202' as if they were owners, and the palette only has 10 tints — for a building with >10 combined keys (e.g. 6 flats => 6 owners + 6 flat-number keys) the tints wrap and two different owners get the SAME tint, breaking the 'different owners get different tints' requirement. Use a separate palette for payer flats (or key on owner name for payer cells) and/or extend the tint list. Failing test: test_ledger_colour_key_lists_only_owners.
format=bogus is not validated — it silently falls back to PDF (200 application/pdf) instead of 400/422. Failing test: test_unknown_format_silently_returns_pdf.

month is NOT validated on the maintenance side (rentals uses valid_month()). month='bad' returns a 200 workbook, and because build_statement upserts a period document a read-only GET CREATES junk periods (I created and then had to delete 'bad', '2026-01', '2027-03' directly from Mongo). Add MONTH_RE validation and make the statement builder non-mutating for reads.
Meter tints are keyed on the meter LABEL, so two different flats that use the same label (e.g. both named 'Meter 1') would share a tint. Key on meter id instead.
STILL OPEN (iter 9/10): PaymentIn.direction is free-form str; non-'received'/'payout' values render as 'Payout' in the Excel Ledger too. Use Literal['received','payout'].
STILL OPEN (iter 8/9, accepted by design): prev_outstanding() master fallback shows a previous-month due for a unit with no lease dates.

issues: No frozen panes and no colour key explaining the 'Fronted by' row tints, unlike the other four sheets (cosmetic consistency).
Pre-existing (iter 10): the 15(+1)-column table overflows the container at 1920px, last columns need horizontal scroll with no scroll affordance.

design_issues.screen: Water / Charges / Reconciliation forms, rentals month picker
issues: Pre-existing: native input type=date / type=month instead of the shadcn calendar component.

action_items: Split the owner colour palette: use a separate Palette for tanker/charge payer flat numbers so the Ledger 'Colour key — owner' only lists owners, and extend OWNER_TINTS (or generate tints) so >10 owners never share a tint.
Reject unknown ?format values with 400 instead of silently returning PDF.
Validate month (YYYY-MM) on /api/mis/export and /api/statement, and stop the read-only statement build from upserting period documents.
Key meter tints on meter id rather than label.
Optional: add frozen panes + a 'Colour key — fronted by' block to the Charges sheet.

Note for the product: there is no PUT/PATCH /api/meters/{id} and the Setup UI only allows add/delete, so 'rename a meter in Building Setup' is not possible today (verified 405). Verbatim writing was instead proven with a newly created special-character label.
critical_code_review_comments: xlsx.Palette wraps silently once keys exceed len(tints) — two entities then share a colour with no warning; generate tints programmatically (e.g. HSL walk) or assert/extend.
build_mis_workbook() passes the same `owners` palette to tankers/charges keyed by flat number — semantic key collision with owner names; also means colour_key() output depends on sheet build order.
server.py is 1321 lines — build_mis_workbook (~140 lines) belongs in xlsx.py / a reports module (>700-line guideline).
xlsx.table() auto-width branch does max() over all rows on every column — fine for month packs but O(rows*cols); pass widths (already done for most tables).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 export buttons visible, clickable and downloading; no console errors)

seed_data_creation: Temporary and fully removed: 2 rental collections (cash + bank/TEST-NEFT-9001), 1 rental payout (TEST-UPI-77), 1 rental deposit, 1 extra meter on flat 101, 1 owner rename — all restored/deleted; also deleted 3 junk period docs ('bad','2026-01','2027-03') that my own export edge-case calls created via build_statement's upsert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new suite with `python -m pytest tests/test_iter11_xlsx_export.py -n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope which breaks the session-scoped seed/rename fixtures). Two tests are intentional red flags documenting open defects: test_ledger_colour_key_lists_only_owners (flat numbers leak into the owner colour key) and test_unknown_format_silently_returns_pdf. Data: Sunrise Residency month 2026-08 (4 flats/4 owners/4 meters/6 tankers incl. one with a different tips payer/5 charges/3 payments); rentals data lives in month 2026-08 (NOT 2026-06) with 3 properties and a single UPI collection, so the suite seeds extra collections/payout/deposit itself. Careful: GET /api/mis/export with an arbitrary month CREATES a period doc — do not probe random months.
rca_of_the_issue: The Ledger colour-key defect: build_mis_workbook() creates one X.Palette(OWNER_TINTS) and calls owners.fill(payer) for tanker rows and charge rows where `payer` is a flat number from flat_name, so those flat numbers become palette keys. colour_key() on the Ledger sheet (built last) dumps the whole palette map, printing '101','102','201','202' under the 'Colour key — owner' heading; with more than 10 total keys the modulo tint assignment also makes distinct owners share a fill. Fix: dedicated payer palette or map payer flat -> owner name before filling.
